about: A real map as the stage: the land drawn quietly, then each place lit as it is said (a country filled in, a city or any point marked with its name and a note), a route drawn from stop to stop, and a strip of time along the bottom when the places have dates: where something happened, a voyage, a trade route, a migration, an empire's spread, how something moved across the world over the years.

places.about: the places in the order they are said, split by |: a country, a city, or any point as Name:latitude,longitude

notes.about: a short note under each place, split by | (empty ones keep their place)

dates.about: a date for each place, split by |; given, a strip of time runs along the bottom and follows the places (empty ones keep their place)

route.about: 1 draws a way from each place to the next as it is reached, for a journey, a route or a spread

area.about: what the map shows: empty fits the places with room round them; world; a continent or part of one such as Europe or Western Asia; or a box as lat,lon,lat,lon

highlight.about: places drawn larger in the accent, split by |; else every country lit takes the accent

when.about: moments each place lights up; else when its name is said, or one after another
